method: dumpbin over a synthetic PE containing only each fixed window; the original was opened read-only and never handed to the tool

observed: loop: rcx=[this+0x98]; rax=[rcx]; call [rax+38h]  -> a COM vtable slot
rcx=[rsp+58h]; rax=[rcx]; call [rax+40h] -> next COM slot, then test eax/js on the HRESULT
Initialize.reading: DXGI adapter/output enumeration through the interface stored at this+0x98, using HRESULT checks including DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND.

observed: if [this+0x48] != 0: rax=[rcx]; call [rax+10h]; [this+0x48]=0   -> COM Release of the old swapchain
if [this+0xA0] != 0: rax=[rcx]; call [rax+10h]; [this+0xA0]=0   -> COM Release of the old target
cmp [this] with 0x1800175E8, then call [rax+98h]                -> device virtual creates the new swapchain
CreateSwapChain.reading: Releases the existing swapchain at +0x48 and surface at +0xA0 via vtable slot +0x10 (Release), then dispatches a device virtual at +0x98 to create the new swapchain from RenderDeviceSettings.

what_this_establishes: the two frozen export bodies are decoded and their COM/DXGI call structure is readable
the renderer releases and recreates its swapchain through COM vtable slots, so the presentation lifecycle is recoverable from the shipped plugin
